description: Get the Director's Loan Account (DLA) balance and recent transactions. Shows if director owes company or vice versa, with section 455 tax warnings.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

limit.description: Max number of transactions to return (default 10)

name: get_dla_balance
title: Get Dla Balance
